info.title: HMS Storefront Data
info.description: Agent-payable data rails for HMS storefronts: verified daily car-rental rates per class (Enterprise/Hertz, Columbus pilot) and HOS-aware, 72ft-trailer-filtered overnight truck sleep stops with Jason's Law scarcity scoring, plus weekly US average retail diesel prices (EIA). x402 pay-per-call, USDC on Base (eip155:8453, permit2, facilitator Coinbase CDP); every paid route also advertises accepts[] variants for Polygon, Arbitrum One, Monad, World Chain (same EVM address) and Solana mainnet (own receiver) — one challenge, any one variant pays. Honesty rule: paid pricing auto-activates only when a dataset has >= 1 real verified record (rental rail live at 6 verified records; sleep-stops activated 2026-11-12 at 49 real OSM-extracted records; fuel activated 2026-11-12 at 24 real EIA weekly records); the /v1/coverage endpoint exposes live coverage so agents never pay for empty data.
info.x-guidance: Pay-per-call x402 v2 (scheme exact, USDC — Base permit2 first variant; Polygon/Arbitrum/Monad/World Chain EVM and Solana mainnet variants ride the same challenge, all verified/settled by the Coinbase CDP facilitator). While a dataset has zero real records (check the free /v1/coverage endpoint first), its route serves a free 200 zero-records response and charges nothing. Once coverage >= 1 real record, an unpaid GET on the route returns HTTP 402 with a base64 JSON challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, accepts[].amount in USDC atomic units, top-level extensions.bazaar discovery); pay and replay with the x-payment header to receive 200 JSON plus a PAYMENT-RESPONSE settle receipt. Free: /health, /v1/coverage, and this /openapi.json. Rate limit 20 requests/min/IP.

get.summary: Fetch verified daily car-rental rates per class

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City with verified rate coverage, e.g. Columbus (Columbus, OH pilot)

200.description: Rates payload (car-rental class, daily rate, vendor, source URL, verified_at)

get.summary: Fetch sleep stops for one of 2 corridors

x-payment-info.note: x402 v2 exact/permit2; live at 49 real records (49 real OSM-extracted truck stops, I-70 + I-80/I-76); accepts[] carries 6 variants (Base + Polygon/Arbitrum/Monad/World Chain + Solana mainnet), any one pays

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Origin city/state, e.g. "Columbus, OH" or "Chicago, IL". Loose prefix matching: \"Columbus\" matches \"I-70\" origin, \"Chicago\" matches \"I-80\" origin

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Destination city/state, e.g. "St. Louis, MO" or "Denver, CO"

200.description: Corridor sleep-stops payload: corridor, corridor_from/to, source, extracted_at, record_count, stops[] per stop_schema, data_caveat

402.description: x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED: base64 challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, accepts[0].amount 50000 USDC atomic on Base, top-level extensions.bazaar)

get.summary: Fetch weekly US average diesel prices (24 points)

x-payment-info.note: x402 v2 exact/permit2; live at 24 real weekly records (EIA Gasoline & Diesel Fuel Update, EMD_EPD2D_PTE_NUS_DPG), last refreshed 2026-11-12; accepts[] carries 6 variants (Base + Polygon/Arbitrum/Monad/World Chain + Solana mainnet), any one pays

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Number of trailing weekly points to return (default 24, max 24)

200.description: Weekly diesel series: source, source_url, series_id, updated_at, record_schema, records[] (week_ending, price_usd_per_gallon, region), data_caveat

402.description: x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED: base64 challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, accepts[0].amount 20000 USDC atomic on Base, top-level extensions.bazaar)
